_about: Theme Park World PSX (PAL, SLES-026.88) save format. Machine-readable companion to fable/save.md. Every entry carries a 'src' tag: SOURCED (address in TPW.BIN, loaded at 0x80010000) or INFERRED. Numbers in this file are DECIMAL unless prefixed 0x.

card_file.file_name: 'B' + region ('ESLES-02688' PAL, 'ISLPS-02643' JP, 'ASLUS-01069' US; 0x800BE730 selects) + up to 8 chars of the park name overlaid on '00000000' (lower-case for Sandbox, upper-case for FullSim; 0x80073484)

title_frame.0x004: title, 32 full-width Shift-JIS chars big-endian (0x8006F440), '[TPW Sandbox] name' or '[TPW FullSim] name' ('STP' instead of 'TPW' when region == 2)

0x200.name: checksum
0x200.note: sum of u32 words over [0x204, 0x204+length), zero-padded to 4; duplicate at 0x9FFC; loader requires both equal and matching (0x8006C55C, 0x800708EC)

0x204.name: length
0x204.note: end offset of the payload measured from the file start (composer's running offset). Because the sum starts at 0x204 the summed range overruns the payload by 0x204 bytes

0x214.name: gendata_len
0x214.note: 0 = none; length of the PAKDATA container

0x22A.name: fullsim
0x22A.note: composer stores !sandbox (0x80059A9C ^ 1); loader stores 0x80102D34 := (byte == 0) and auto-opens the park when sandbox

0x22B.name: slot_status
0x22B.note: index park*2+sub; low nibble = SVEDLEV flag (0 open/current, 1 finished, 2 never entered); |0xF0 when a stream is present. Loader loads a stream only when the byte == 0xF0 exactly

0x233.name: progress
0x233.note: 0x8010398C, 0x80103984, 0x80103988 (campaign counters; 0x80103984 forced to 0xFF by 0x8006BE1C when the static 0x80102EC0 is nonzero)

0x23C.name: progress_words
0x23C.note: 0x80109B18[park][sub], 15-bit masks counted by 0x8006BEF0 (INFERRED: golden-ticket / objective completion per park)

0x25C.name: not_option0
0x25C.note: = !0x8010399C[0] (0x8006C0B8); default option value is 1 so a fresh save writes 0

0x26A.name: payload
0x26A.note: GENDATA container (if gendata_len) then park stream containers in slot order; everything up to 0x9FFC zero-filled; max payload end 0x9DF8

pakdata_container.grammar: token c: c < 0x80 -> c+1 literal bytes follow; c >= 0x80 -> back-reference offset c-256 (-128..-1), next byte = length 1..255; length 0 = end of stream (emitted as 80 00). Encoder: first two bytes literal, greedy longest match (first found wins on ties), min match 3, max 255, literal runs flushed at 128.
pakdata_container.verified: fable/sv/pak.py reproduces the game's 1993-byte container for the captured 4596-byte stream byte-for-byte

entry.0x0: u32 heap handle of the PAKDATA container, 0xFFFFFFFF = none
entry.0x4: u8 flag: 2 = never entered (ctor), 0 = playable (create sets (0,0); loader status nibble 0), 1 = finished (loader status nibble 1; frees the stream)

svedlev.written_by: 0x80057EFC (leave park / quit current game) -> 0x8006B8E8(park, sub): serialise the live park with 0x80070A48, PAK it, store the handle
svedlev.read_by: 0x800588D0 (game start) -> 0x8006B92C(park, sub): if the entry has data, UNPAK and run the 21 section readers (0x80071D0C)

park_stream.src: SOURCED writer 0x80070948 (order and sizes), reader 0x80071D0C; primitive 0x80071E48(size, align4) / 0x80070AF0
park_stream.note: record sizes are exact; every record marked align=4 is followed by padding to a 4-byte boundary. Counts in the header are u8. All multi-byte ints little-endian.

fields.0: u16 magic 0x3039 (12345 decimal), not checked by the loader
fields.2: u8 park (loader rejects the stream if != 0x801038A0)

fields.0: u8 park_open (0x800541AC); loader calls OpenPark when nonzero
fields.2: u16 entry fee in pounds (BANK+0 / 10); loader stores fee*10

fields.bitmap: bit i (byte i>>3, bit i&7) for tile (x = i % w, y = i / w) set when the tile type is 2 or 13 (0x8004D4EC / 0x8004D558 = path / queue path); only ceil(w*h/8) bytes carry bits, the rest is uninitialised heap (block LSVE). Loader lays each set tile with the path tool (0x8001B5A0(2), 0x8001BD30(x,y,0,0) twice)

sections.name: visitor_template
sections.note: ALWAYS one record, never per guest

sections.name: litter

fields.0: u8 count of litter objects for which 0x80066958 is false
fields.1: u8 count for which it is true (INFERRED: vomit)

sections.note: restored at random free tiles (0x80053A98); positions are not saved

sections.name: research
sections.align: none for the pairs, 4 after the 16-byte block
sections.note: ABSENT ENTIRELY when the game is in Sandbox (0x80059A9C != 0, both writer 0x800715F0 and reader 0x80072B54)

fields.pairs: for category in [3,7,6,1,2,4,5,8]: count(category) x {u8 progress 0..99, u8 level}; counts come from the level tables (0x800DDDC4[park] + 4*sub, offsets +16,+32,+48,+80,+96,+112,+128,+64), NOT from the stream. Park 0 sub 0 live: 8,0,1,1,13,6,3,2
fields.tail_16: u8 [research-object+4]; 5 x {u8 active, u8 category, i8 index} = the research slots (0x8009B28C / 0x8009B2EC / 0x8009B448)

sections.name: messages

fields.each: align 2; i16 id; if id == -1: u8 len, len bytes text; u8 kind; i8 subject_type (-1 none); if subject_type != -1: u8 subject_index

sections.note: INFERRED: pending advisor/message-window queue (manager 0x8010988C, ctor 0x8003A7BC, append 0x800385AC)

park_stream.trailer: the SAVE heap block is rounded up to 4 bytes, so 0..3 undefined bytes may follow the last section
park_stream.after_load: 0x800505A8 is called once all sections are read (0x80071DE0)

fields.0: u32 -> A+0x14 guests served, all time
fields.4: u8 type (slot 16 value; 0x80063208) 1/3/6/7 rides, shops/features/sideshows their own

building_base.note: after the fields the loader calls slot 39 with arg 1 (commit placement)

fields.8: i16 queue_x[32]/i16 queue_y[32] interleaved (4 bytes per point)
fields.144: u8 status (slot 57 SetStatus); if 4..6 the loader also spawns the breakdown effect and sets status 4
fields.148: u8 variant (catalogue index, used to allocate)

fields.230: i8 pairs at 0xE6+2i (count from byte 236) -> A+0x1CF2

track_ride.note: field semantics INFERRED (track piece x/y); sizes SOURCED

fields.148: u32: bits 0-7 variant, bits 8-13 element count (<=63), bits 14-15 flags -> 0x800ADEA0 when set

coaster.note: element semantics INFERRED (track segment geometry); layout SOURCED

visitor_template.src: SOURCED writer 0x80070FA4 (min/max over all guests), reader 0x80091A3C

fields.0: u8 base, u8 range : rubbish V+0x58
fields.16: u16 base, u16 range : money V+0x48 (tenths of a pound)

visitor_template.restore: for each of header.n_visitors: new guest (0x80051480), position := exit point 1 (0x800599A4(1)), state 45, each attribute := base + D(range+1) where D = (rand(n)+rand(n))/2 for offsets 0,2,16,20,22,24 (0x8009197C) and n - rand(n)*rand(n)/n for offsets 6,10,12,14 (0x800919C4); type := rand(8)

person.src: SOURCED writer 0x80094BBC, reader 0x80094C64; allocators 0x80051640 guard, 0x80051850 researcher, 0x800516F0 mechanic, 0x800517A0 handyman, 0x80051900 entertainer, all (variant)

fields.4: u32 hire day (P+0x34, McAi total days)
fields.8: u8 variant (slot 53 get / slot 52 set); the name comes from the catalogue, it is not stored
fields.9: u8 bits 0-2 level (P+0x3C & 7), bit 7 = was striking (state 15)

person.note: position is not saved; 0x8009386C re-places the person

fields.0: 8 x money_history(80): month-end balance, income, entry fees, shop profit, sideshow takings, spend, wages, park value (BANK+0xBC..+0x107C order)

bank.note: all-time and yearly figures are stored via 0x80088E18 = value/10 (pounds) and restored x10 (0x80088E50); the balance and history values are stored raw (tenths). Entry fee is NOT here (it is in open_fee). Captured: 780 = 80 = two GBP 40 admissions.

fields.56: u8[6] months 13..24 as pair averages, quantised: byte = (v-min)*255/(max-min)
fields.62: u8[8] months 25..72 as six-month averages, quantised
fields.70: u8[9] months 73..144 as eight-month averages, quantised

money_history.note: tiers 62..79 INFERRED by structure of the reader loops (constants /6, /8, x0x80808081 = /255); the 12 exact months and the pair tier are read

fields.43: 5 x u8_history(35) -> McAi+0x28+0x90*i (144 monthly bytes each)

mcai.note: the five (u32,u8,bit) triples and the five histories are INFERRED to be objective/park-rating tracks; the calendar fields are SOURCED via economy.md/wages.md offsets

gendata.src: SOURCED 0x80070A9C (writer), 0x80071E04 (reader), 0x80013A60/0x80013A9C thunks -> vtable 0x800DBB3C slots 2/3 = 0x8001758C / 0x80017594 which are 'jr ra'
gendata.layout: 25 bytes written from an UNINITIALISED stack buffer (the serialise virtual is a no-op in this build), pad to 28, 1 more uninitialised byte, pad to 32
gendata.effect_on_load: none (the load virtual is also a no-op)

flow.save: Laptop > Game Options > Save Game -> 0x80073484(port, name, fullsim): sprintf title, compose (0x8006C0E4), nblocks = ceil(size/8192) = 5, suffix = 8 chars of name case-toggled, card op 6 (create+write, 0x8007046C) with up to 5 retries; 0x80073678 overwrites an existing slot
flow.load: Main menu > Load Game -> directory listing op (0x8006FEF0, wildcard '*') -> per file with 12-char prefix match and 'SC' title (0x80070080) -> 0x80073378: read the whole file (op 5, 0x800702BC) into a LOADING buffer of nblocks*8192, then 0x8006C524 validates and installs SVEDLEV/GENDATA/options; up to 5 retries
flow.park_enter: 0x800588D0 -> 0x8006B9F8 (apply GENDATA: no-op) and 0x8006B92C (restore park if SVEDLEV entry has data), otherwise the level starts fresh

loader_rejects: file shorter than 5 blocks (0x9FFC word unreadable)
a stream whose header park/sub != current park/sub (stream silently skipped, park starts fresh)
a slot status byte with a stream but flag != 0 (byte != 0xF0): stream ignored
not_located: terrain heightmap: NOT in the save; it comes from the level (park id). Only the path bitmap is saved
scenery/trees placed by the player: no section exists for them (if the build allows placing them they are lost on save)
shop record fields at +8 and +23 (A+0x84, A+0x80): purpose unknown
